harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured `/srv/data` as an XFS filesystem on LVM, captured a filesystem-consistent snapshot, modified the application data, and restored the exact earlier state. Boot-safe activation was configured and verified after reboot. CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 were retained.
actions_performed: Created a dedicated 2 GiB LVM logical volume for `/srv/data` using existing compatible tooling.
Configured persistent loop-device activation and systemd mounting.
Created representative application data and recorded file and whole-tree SHA-256 baselines.
Created the `prechange` LVM snapshot while the filesystem was frozen.
Changed both original files and added a new post-snapshot file.
Merged the snapshot and verified the restored tree exactly matched the baseline; the added file disappeared.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified changed boot identity, storage activation, mounted data, services, and identical content.

evidence.requirement: Keep application data under `/srv/data` on snapshot-capable storage
evidence.summary: Shows the LVM PV/VG/LV, XFS filesystem mounted at `/srv/data`, application files, and persistent systemd/fstab configuration.

evidence.requirement: Capture an earlier filesystem snapshot and demonstrate later modification
evidence.summary: Shows the filesystem-consistent `prechange` snapshot, baseline hashes, divergent modified hashes, and the additional post-snapshot file.

evidence.requirement: Restore the exact content captured by the earlier snapshot
evidence.summary: Shows the snapshot merge reaching 100%, LV reactivation/remount, matching per-file and whole-tree hashes, restored original content, and removal of post-snapshot data.

evidence.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64.

Captures healthy pre-restart data with boot ID df8bab0d-5c09-47a2-a150-4ce12d0f9549, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID a5f00a13-77f6-4315-a515-16f0ea1797f8, recovered services and mount, and byte-identical application data after reboot.

attempts.summary: Configured `/srv/data` as an XFS filesystem on LVM, captured a filesystem-consistent snapshot, modified the application data, and restored the exact earlier state. Boot-safe activation was configured and verified after reboot. CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 were retained.
